# AI Security for Builders — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Apply OWASP LLM Top 10 controls
- Defend against direct and indirect prompt injection
- Enforce ACLs in retrieval and agents
- Red-team AI systems

## The sentences to remember

1. **Threat model your LLM system** — “Anywhere untrusted text can reach your prompt is an input field for the attacker. Draw those arrows first.”
2. **Controls: implement five and measure what each one stops** — “No single control stops everything. Defence in depth means each attack has to get lucky five times.”
3. **Red-teaming: an attack library, automated probing and a findings report** — “You will never enumerate every prompt. Make sure the tool refuses the refund even when the model has been convinced.”
4. **Governance hooks: security review in the lifecycle and the metrics** — “Security that lives outside the delivery gates gets done after launch. Which is to say, after the incident.”
